types.name: transfer.v1.CreateInternalTransferRequest
types.doc:
CreateInternalTransferRequest creates or returns one accepted Trading
 to Trading internal transfer for the authenticated source account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional source subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated
 caller's root account is used as the source account.

fields.name: destination_account_id
fields.doc: Destination root account public id.

fields.name: destination_subaccount_id
fields.doc: Destination subaccount public id.

fields.name: destination_smart_account_address
fields.doc: Destination smart-account address.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id for the asset being transferred.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.
 For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Stable client-supplied idempotency key used to collapse safe retries.

types.name: transfer.v1.CreateInternalTransferResponse
types.doc:
CreateInternalTransferResponse returns the accepted request and transfer
 identifiers for later correlation.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Stable server-owned request identifier for this intake.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Stable transfer identifier for the settled internal transfer.

fields.name: accepted_at_ts_ns
fields.doc: Acceptance timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (server time).

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Echoed canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: asset_code
fields.doc: Resolved asset code for convenience.

fields.name: u_asset_id
fields.doc: Resolved unified asset id used by downstream settlement.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Echoed transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.

fields.name: destination
fields.doc: Server-resolved destination summary.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Public status for the transfer request.

types.name: transfer.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode identifies stable, machine-readable Internal Transfer API errors.
 Values mirror the REST problem+json code field.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
values.doc: The source account does not have enough available Trading balance.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request payload or one of its fields is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Caller is not authenticated.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: Caller is not permitted to create the transfer.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
values.doc: Request exceeded the applicable admission rate limit.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: The selected subaccount identifier is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The selected subaccount does not exist.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SOURCE_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE
values.doc: The source subaccount is not active.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNSUPPORTED_ASSET
values.doc: The requested asset is not supported for internal transfers.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_AMOUNT
values.doc: The transfer amount is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION
values.doc: The destination identifier is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The destination account or smart account could not be found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_INACTIVE
values.doc: The destination subaccount is not active.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SAME_SOURCE_DESTINATION
values.doc: Source and destination resolve to the same account.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_NOT_WHITELISTED
values.doc: The destination is not present on the caller's internal whitelist.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SMART_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required source or destination smart-account address is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Fresh step-up verification is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was reused with different request data.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FUNDS_LOCK_CONFLICT
values.doc: The funds lock conflicts with an existing or finalized reservation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CAPITAL_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The authoritative capital view is not ready or is stale.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ACCOUNT_SHARD_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The account shard cannot currently accept fund movement.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_DENIED
values.doc: A required account or API-key policy rejected the transfer.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_PRECONDITION
values.doc: A required precondition was not satisfied.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The requested resource was not found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT
values.doc: The request conflicts with existing state.

types.name: transfer.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc: ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json code field.

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferStatus
types.doc:
InternalTransferStatus is the public user-facing status for an internal
 transfer request.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_ACCEPTED
values.doc: The transfer request was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_REJECTED
values.doc: The transfer request was rejected before durable acceptance.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_FAILED
values.doc: The transfer request failed terminally before durable acceptance.

types.name: transfer.v1.ResolvedDestination
types.doc:
ResolvedDestination describes the normalized transfer destination selected by
 the server after public-id / smart-account resolution.

fields.name: root_account_public_id
fields.doc: Destination root account public id.

fields.name: subaccount_public_id
fields.doc: Destination subaccount public id when the destination targets a subaccount.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Destination smart-account address resolved by the server.
